text:
I fixed six bugs in `catalog/`, but I haven't run `python3 -m unittest`. I have no shell in this session, so none of the fixes have been tested. Please run it to confirm.

- **`fees.py`:** `late_fee` added the daily fee to the number of days late. It now multiplies.
- **`members.py`:** `MAX_BORROWED` was 3 and is now 5, which is what the tests and the comment above it expect.
- **`inventory.py`:** `recent(n)` returned `n+1` events. It now returns the last `n`, and an empty list when `n` is 0 or less.
- **`factory.py`:** `sample_books` was missing a third book. I added `Emma` by Austen, 1815, 1 copy. The tests only check the title, so I made up the author, year and copy count.
- **`books.py`:** `parse_book` kept the year as a string. It now converts it to an int.
- **`search.py`:** it imported `normalize` from `catalog.nonexistent`. It now imports it from `catalog.text`.
